candidates.public_label: Doors-off helicopter pilot hazard warnings and deficient safety management
candidates.artifact_summary: Official NTSB records preserve repeated operational warnings about tether entanglement, emergency egress, cutting tools, and flotation, management nonresponse, and a later accident in which those hazards contributed to five deaths.
missing_receipts: original pilot warning emails or reports
individual authorship and recipient acknowledgment
complete response chain for each warning
support and authority ledger
independent handoff or cross-domain transfer evidence
candidates.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the warnings were not made before the accident, did not concern the later contributing hazards, or received technically adequate corrective action would defeat or narrow advancement.

candidates.public_label: Merits-based retraction after a final research-misconduct finding
candidates.artifact_summary: The federal record preserves a final misconduct finding and linked publication retractions, providing a control against treating every publication gate or retraction as suppression of a misunderstood outsider.
missing_receipts: original complainant allegation and complete institutional file
full appeal or settlement record if any
evidence sufficient to generalize beyond this case
candidates.falsifier: A reversal of the final misconduct finding or evidence that the cited retractions were unrelated to the adjudicated conduct would defeat the control.

candidates.public_label: Tank-car safety recommendation persistence without completed event inference
candidates.artifact_summary: Official NTSB records preserve a decades-long recommendation stream concerning DOT-111 vulnerability, repeated event receipts, partial regulatory implementation, and renewed phase-out recommendations.
missing_receipts: one bounded specialist-authored work object tied to one decision gate
complete regulator response chronology for each recommendation
person-level authorship support and handoff evidence
candidates.falsifier: A record showing that the recommendation stream was fully implemented before the cited events or that the cited events did not involve the identified vulnerability would narrow the mechanism finding.

candidates.public_label: Special prosecutor removal order and attorney-general refusal
candidates.artifact_summary: Federal records preserve preexisting commitments to special-prosecutor independence, a direct order to discharge the prosecutor, a written refusal and resignation, a second refusal, and eventual execution by the next official.
missing_receipts: complete legal analysis underlying the refusal
support and authority ledger normalized against the office
independent handoff receipt preserving the object after resignation
cross-domain transfer artifact
evidence of model update after contradiction rather than principled refusal alone
candidates.falsifier: A contemporaneous record showing no prior commitment, no direct refusal, or an independently sufficient ordinary reason for resignation unrelated to the discharge order would defeat advancement.

candidates.public_label: Institutional reversal of a carelessness finding
candidates.artifact_summary: The institution formally reversed an earlier carelessness finding after external expert review, reassigned the error to a systemic process, and cleared the researcher of the prior suspicion.
missing_receipts: pre-decision and post-decision employment and funding state
complete collaboration and custody state
evidence of timely voluntary repair before external review
durable handoff or relationship repair
candidates.falsifier: A later authoritative record reinstating the carelessness finding or showing that no formal record was corrected would defeat the mechanism finding.

candidates.public_label: Editorial endorsement veto and disputed assignment of silence
candidates.artifact_summary: Public reporting preserves a disputed authorship-transfer surface—owner-assigned silence versus editor-described veto—and resulting resignations, but not the complete internal record or independent adjudication.
missing_receipts: proposed endorsement and revision history
complete owner-editor communications
formal governance and decision authority record
independent adjudication of competing accounts
durable post-dispute custody and relationship state
candidates.falsifier: Complete records showing that no endorsement was proposed or that the board independently chose silence without owner intervention would defeat the veto account.
